summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the definition and implementation of 'public campaigns.' Initially, it was suggested that a public campaign acts as an overarching 'meta-campaign' visible to all publishers, which would be relevant when media agencies are integrated into the system.

However, consensus shifted toward focusing initially on local campaigns created by individual publishers. The current requirement is for multiple publishers to submit separate campaigns for the same advertiser order. Future functionality should allow a role (or user) to analyze these multiple related campaigns as a group, without needing complex merging.

The concept of a 'dominant' or 'top-level' campaign was discussed, suggesting that such a campaign could be owned by one publisher but visible in read-only mode to others. The immediate focus remains on building functionality from the bottom (local) level up.
decisions: Initial development will focus on local campaigns created independently by publishers.
